description:
[Deterministic trade compliance engine. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates dual-use export control regimes and licensing requirements under Regulation (EU) 2021/821 (Annex I & II, Union General Export Authorisations EU001-EU008) and destination sanctions embargoes (e.g. Russia, Iran).
Usage: Use this tool to verify whether high-tech, cyber-surveillance, encryption, or advanced electronic items require individual export authorization before shipment.
Returns: JSON object with { isControlled: boolean, licensingRequirement: 'NONE' | 'INDIVIDUAL_LICENSE' | 'GLOBAL_LICENSE' | 'PROHIBITED', applicableUgea: string | null, legalBasis: string, warningFlags: string[] }.

destinationCountry.description: 2-letter ISO country code of destination (e.g. US, RU, CN, CH, GB)

isMilitaryEndUser.description: Whether the recipient is a military or defense entity

name: dual_use_export_control
